notes: The Hebrew has no conjunction before ʾeṯ-hāʿōḇərîm, so the ASV's 'and' at t016 is added under rule 14's last sentence rather than folded into the object marker.
s010 takes 'with' because the ASV spends that word on the marked phrase's relation (reading ʾēṯ as H854); the second marker is unrepresented, its object written bare.
'through' after each ʿāḇar is the verb's phrasal particle, as the chapter's other passes show, so bā at s006 keeps nothing (rule 40).
